Video Trimmer By NemoVideo v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Upload video files up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) for fast AI-powered trimming and export.
- Describe desired edits in plain language; backend processes instructions and returns 1080p MP4.
- Automatic token-based authentication and session management with up to 100 free credits.
- Supports quick trims, cut segments, adding BGM or text overlays, and batch video handling.
- Clear error handling for unsupported formats, credit issues, and export restrictions.
- Designed for rapid content creation without the need for complex editing software.
